segments.text: In spring, the cherry blossoms begin to open. Last winter was especially harsh, and many people were anxious waiting for the blossoms.
Cherry blossoms are a special flower for the Japanese
Since ancient times they have been written into poems
Drawn in paintings and have become a feature of the culture
The custom of holding a flower viewing party
Under the cherry trees has a history of more than a thousand years
When we see the cherry trees in full bloom
Everyone holds their breath
The sight of petals dancing in the wind
Is astonishing in its beauty
But the beauty of the cherry blossom lies in its gravity
In about a week, the flowers fall, the petals pile on the ground like a carpet
That seem to has a unique beauty
In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent mono-nowhere
A quiet sadness and love toward that which inevitably fades
Because the time of bloom is short, it feels all the more beautiful
Life too is as fleeting as cherry blossoms
A decade looking back passes in an instant
Youth, health, time with loved ones
None of it will last forever
That is why we should cherish this moment
Right now, under the cherry trees
To speak with friends, laugh with family
And quietly look up at the sky alone
The sum of such small moments is life itself
The cherry trees bloomed again this year
Next year and the year after
I want to see as many cherry blossoms as I can
That simple wish is what keeps us alive
